alt.da: Curated tablet-plate af P4P operations-rummet med køkkenflow, ordrestatus og lokal nodestatus.
alt.en: Curated tablet plate of the P4P operations room showing kitchen flow, order status, and local node state.

github_readme.en: Pilot-node operations room: incoming orders, kitchen flow, and local state stay on the restaurant-owned node.

github_review.en: This is the local operations room in the controlled pilot path. It shows what the restaurant controls itself after discovery.

pizza_home.en: What the restaurant will control locally when the controlled pilot opens.

pizza_press.da: Det lokale driftsrum til ordrer, køkken og nodestatus. Hører til den kontrollerede pilot, ikke det nuværende v0.1-proof.
pizza_press.en: The local operations room for orders, kitchen flow, and node status. Part of the controlled pilot, not the current v0.1 proof.

alt.da: Curated tablet-plate af P4P catalog-rummet med lokale menuitems og redigering.
alt.en: Curated tablet plate of the P4P catalog room showing local menu items and editing controls.

github_readme.en: The shop keeps its own structured menu and edits it locally on the node.

github_review.en: Catalog work is separated from live operations. Menu truth stays local to the restaurant-owned node.

pizza_home.en: Menu editing belongs to the shop, not to the discovery layer.

pizza_press.da: Menuen og katalogsandheden bliver redigeret lokalt på noden i stedet for at bo i en marketplace-backoffice.
pizza_press.en: The menu and catalog truth are edited locally on the node instead of living inside a marketplace backoffice.

alt.da: Curated tablet-plate af P4P modules-rummet med current modules, desired modules og restart-krav.
alt.en: Curated tablet plate of the P4P modules room showing current modules, desired modules, and restart-required truth.

github_readme.en: Module control stays local: current state, desired state, and restart-required truth are visible on the node.

github_review.en: This room keeps module changes explicit. Discovery, import, and desired runtime selection are separate concerns.

pizza_home.en: The pilot node shows clearly when the running module set and the desired module set differ.

pizza_press.da: Butikken kan se hvilke moduler der kører nu, hvilke der ønskes efter restart, og hvornår runtime sandt nok skal genstartes.
pizza_press.en: The shop can see which modules run now, which are desired after restart, and when the runtime honestly needs a restart.

protocols_catalog.da: Lokalt modulvalg sker på noden: kører nu, ønskes efter restart, og restart-krav bliver vist ærligt.

protocols_shop.da: Shop-familien bliver ikke bare læst offentligt. Den kan også vælges og styres lokalt på noden.

alt.da: Curated tablet-plate af P4P discover-rummet, hvor det offentlige modul-katalog bliver læst inde i den lokale node-shell.
alt.en: Curated tablet plate of the P4P discover room, where the public module catalog is read inside the local node shell.

github_review.en: Discover is the bridge between the public module catalog and the local node. It stays read-only in this phase.

pizza_press.da: Discover-rummet forbinder det offentlige modul-katalog med den lokale node uden at gøre noden til en app store.
pizza_press.en: The Discover room connects the public module catalog to the local node without turning the node into an app store.

protocols_catalog.da: Det offentlige modul-katalog kan læses direkte inde fra noden som en separat discovery-surface.

protocols_shop.da: Før butikken ændrer noget, kan den læse den offentlige modul-forklaring lokalt i Discover-rummet.

alt.da: Curated tablet-plate af P4P import-rummet med et lokalt uploadet modulmanifest som metadata på noden.
alt.en: Curated tablet plate of the P4P import room showing a locally uploaded module manifest stored as metadata on the node.

github_review.en: Local module import exists as a metadata-only phase. The node becomes aware of a manifest before anything becomes runnable.

pizza_press.da: Et hjemmelavet eller eksternt modul kan gøres synligt på noden som metadata, før det bliver en del af runtime.
pizza_press.en: A homebuilt or external module can become visible on the node as metadata before it becomes part of the runtime.

protocols_shop.da: Import-rummet gør lokale modulmanifester synlige på noden uden at gøre dem runnable med det samme.

alt.da: Curated tablet-plate af P4P moduldetaljesiden for OCR-importmodulet med owner-first forklaring og lokal status.
alt.en: Curated tablet plate of the P4P module detail page for the OCR import module, with owner-first explanation and local status.

github_review.en: Each module can become a real operator page instead of only a flat status row.

pizza_press.da: Et modul kan få sin egen lokale side med formål, grænser, status og handlinger i stedet for bare at være en teknisk række.
pizza_press.en: A module can have its own local page with purpose, boundaries, status, and actions instead of being only a technical row.

protocols_shop.da: Shop-familien bliver mere ærlig, når hvert modul kan læses som sin egen lokale operatorside.

alt.da: Curated plate af den offentlige Protocols4People-side for shop-modulfamilien.
alt.en: Curated plate of the public Protocols4People page for the shop module family.

github_review.en: The public module family surface explains the local node stack in human language before GitHub manifests and docs.

pizza_press.da: Protocols4People giver den generelle, menneskelige læsning af shop-modulerne før de lokale node-sider og GitHub-kontrakter.
pizza_press.en: Protocols4People gives the generic human reading of the shop modules before the local node rooms and GitHub contracts.

protocols_catalog.da: Shop-familien er den første offentlige indgang til modul-laget på Protocols4People.
